entities.name: Cathedral of the Assumption of Blessed Virgin Mary in Aleppo
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Cathedral of Our Lady of Assumption, is an Eastern Catholic (Syriac) church in Aleppo, Syria, located in the Christian quarter of al-Jdayde. The current church was built in 1970, replacing the old cathedral. Due to the Syrian civil war it was closed from 2012 to 2018.
